fact: Delft Imaging's February 2020 magazine piece says Eritrea's Ministry of Health is joining forces with Delft Imaging and Thirona to use the offline CAD4TB chest X-ray AI to screen for TB, with no screening figures given.

Delft Imaging says Eritrea's Ministry of Health had 2 Delft Light and 6 CAD4TB units deployed in 2024 to detect TB-related abnormalities automatically, and expanded the roll-out with 8 more CAD4TB in 2026.
